# Home Security Intelligence

> AI-powered home security monitoring with real-time object detection and LLM-based risk analysis. Self-hosted, privacy-first. Fully containerized with GPU passthrough.

## For AI Assistants (Cursor, Claude, etc.)

This file provides deployment and architecture context for LLM-powered coding assistants.

**Key entry points:**
- `docker-compose.prod.yml` - Container orchestration (core + monitoring stack; `ai-gateway` is the single AI entrypoint)
- `backend/` - Python FastAPI backend (REST API, WebSocket, AI pipeline)
- `frontend/` - React TypeScript dashboard (Tailwind + Tremor)
- `ai/` - AI service code (`ai/gateway/` serves all detection/enrichment models via Triton; `ai/nemotron/` is the standalone llama.cpp LLM container)

**Architecture:**
```
Cameras (FTP) --> FileWatcher --> YOLO26 --> Batch Aggregator --> Nemotron --> Dashboard
                                (via ai-gateway :8090)          (llama.cpp :8091)
```

## Quick Deploy (First Time)

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence.git
cd nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence

# 2. Configure environment (setup.py generates .env interactively; or copy the template)
python setup.py            # or: cp .env.example .env

# 3. Download AI models (~33GB total per the setup_lib download rule; takes 30-90 min on fast connection)
./ai/download_models.sh

# 4. Start all services (builds AI containers on first run)
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d

# 5. Wait for AI models to load (~2-3 min)
watch -n 5 'curl -s http://localhost:8000/api/system/health/ready'
```

**Access:** https://localhost:8444 (Dashboard, nginx container; plain HTTP on host 8080 for tunnel setups) | http://localhost:8000/docs (API)

> First launch requires admin registration: `SetupGuardMiddleware` returns 503 on most API routes until the first user is created via the browser setup flow.

## Update Deployment (GHCR)

Pre-built frontend/backend/ai-llm containers are published to GitHub Container Registry (`docker-compose.ghcr.yml`). AI gateway images publish too; build locally when GPU-specific rebuilds are needed.

```bash
# Pull latest frontend + backend from GHCR
podman pull ghcr.io/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/backend:latest
podman pull ghcr.io/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/frontend:latest

# Rebuild AI containers if ai/ code changed
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build ai-gateway ai-llm

# Restart everything
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

## GPU Requirements

| VRAM | Capability | Example GPUs |
|------|------------|--------------|
| **24GB** | Full stack, all models loaded | RTX 3090, 4090, A5000, A5500, A6000 |
| **16GB** | Reduced GPU layers (`GPU_LAYERS`) | RTX 4080, A4000 |
| **12GB** | Minimal mode, some CPU offload | RTX 3080, 4070 Ti |

**VRAM budget:** Nemotron Q4_K_M GGUF is ~14.7GB on disk (`models.yml` size_mb 15073) and ~21GB resident when fully on GPU (`backend/services/model_zoo.py:36` — 21,700 MB); detection/enrichment models load on demand through the gateway with LRU eviction. `GPU_LAYERS=auto` (default) fits the LLM to available VRAM.

## AI Models (~33GB total — 25 entries per the setup_lib download rule)

The download script (`./ai/download_models.sh`) fetches all required models:

| Model | Size | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| Nemotron-3-Nano-30B (Q4_K_M) | ~14.7GB | Risk reasoning LLM |
| YOLO26 (n/s/m) | ~67MB | Object detection |
| Florence-2-Large (legacy) | ~3GB | Vision-language (gateway loads Florence-2-base, ~1GB, `models.yml`) |
| CLIP-ViT-L (legacy) | ~1.7GB | Re-ID (gateway's `/clip` router runs SigLIP 2 Base, ~400MB on disk / ~200MB VRAM) |
| Fashion-CLIP | ~3.5GB | Clothing classification |
| Vehicle-Segment-Classification | ~350MB | Vehicle types |
| Pet-Classifier (resnet-18) | ~45MB | Cat/dog detection |
| Depth-Anything-V2-Tiny | ~98MB | Depth estimation |
| Model Zoo remainder | ~19GB | Weather, pose, violence, plate OCR, etc. |

### Custom Model Path

Default installation path: `/export/ai_models`

To use a custom path:
```bash
# Set before running download script
export AI_MODELS_PATH=/your/custom/path
./ai/download_models.sh

# Also set when starting containers
AI_MODELS_PATH=/your/custom/path podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

### Directory Structure (after download)

```
${AI_MODELS_PATH}/
├── nemotron/
│   └── nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b-q4km/  # Nemotron LLM (.gguf)
└── model-zoo/
    ├── florence-2-large/              # Vision-language
    ├── clip-vit-l/                    # Embeddings
    ├── fashion-clip/                  # Clothing
    ├── vehicle-segment-classification/ # Vehicles
    ├── pet-classifier/                # Pets
    ├── vitpose-plus-small/            # Pose
    └── depth-anything-v2-tiny/        # Depth
```

## Services & Ports

Host port defaults come from `.env` / `.env.example`; `docs/reference/config/env-reference.md` is the authoritative reference.

### Core Services

| Service | Host Port | Container | GPU | Description |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-----|-------------|
| Frontend HTTPS | 8444 | frontend | No | React dashboard via nginx (internal 8443) |
| Frontend HTTP | 8080 | frontend | No | nginx HTTP for Cloudflare tunnel / Brev link (internal 8080) |
| Backend | 8000 | backend | No | FastAPI REST + WebSocket |
| PostgreSQL | 5432 | postgres | No | Event/detection storage |
| Redis | 6379 | redis | No | Queues and pub/sub |
| go2rtc API | 1984 | go2rtc | No | Stream management API |
| go2rtc WebRTC | 8555 | go2rtc | No | Browser WebRTC streaming |
| AI Gateway | 8090 | ai-gateway | Yes | Triton routers: `/yolo26` `/florence` `/clip` `/enrichment` `/enrich-lt` |
| Nemotron | 8091 | ai-llm | Yes | llama.cpp risk-analysis LLM |
| vLLM (optional) | 8097 | ai-llm-vllm | Yes | Compose profile `vllm`, off by default |

> Since commit bc7d6101 the standalone YOLO26/Florence/CLIP/enrichment containers are gone — those models run inside `ai-gateway`. The legacy `YOLO26_PORT=8095`, `FLORENCE_PORT=8092`, `CLIP_PORT=8093`, `ENRICHMENT_PORT=8094`, `ENRICHMENT_LIGHT_PORT=8096` values in `.env.example` are reference/local-dev only. `FRONTEND_PORT=5173` is likewise no longer mapped by prod compose.

### Monitoring Services

| Service | Port | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Prometheus | 9090 | Metrics collection |
| Grafana | 3002 | Dashboards (proxied at /grafana via nginx) |
| Tempo | 3200 | Distributed tracing (replaces Jaeger) |
| Loki | 3100 | Log aggregation |
| Pyroscope | 4040 | Continuous profiling |
| Alertmanager | 9093 | Alert routing |
| Alloy | 12345 | Log/metrics collector UI |
| Redis Exporter | 9121 | Redis metrics |
| JSON Exporter | 7979 | Custom metrics |
| Node / DCGM / Blackbox exporters | 9100 / 9400 / 9115 | Host, GPU, endpoint metrics |

## Common Commands

```bash
# Start all services
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d

# View logs
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f backend
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f ai-llm

# Check health
curl http://localhost:8000/api/system/health/ready

# Stop services
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down

# GPU memory check
nvidia-smi

# Database shell
podman exec -it $(podman ps -qf name=postgres) psql -U security -d security
```

## Deploy from CI/CD Containers

Pull and redeploy using pre-built containers from GitHub Container Registry:

```bash
# Pull latest containers from GHCR (main branch)
podman pull ghcr.io/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/backend:latest
podman pull ghcr.io/mikesvoboda/nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/frontend:latest

# Redeploy
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
podman-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

## Auto-Start on Boot

| Platform | Command |
|----------|---------|
| Linux (systemd) | `./scripts/setup-systemd.sh` |
| macOS (launchd) | `./scripts/setup-launchd.sh` |
| Windows (Task Scheduler) | `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\setup-windows.ps1` |

## Troubleshooting

**Container won't start (port in use):**
```bash
ss -tlnp | grep 8000  # Find what's using the port
```

**GPU not available:**
```bash
podman run --rm --device nvidia.com/gpu=all nvidia/cuda:12.4-base nvidia-smi
```

**Out of VRAM:**
```bash
# In .env: reduce LLM GPU layers (default: auto = fit to VRAM)
GPU_LAYERS=30
```

**AI service slow/not responding:**
```bash
curl http://localhost:8090/health  # AI gateway
curl http://localhost:8091/health  # Nemotron
# First request after startup is slow (model loading)
```

## Project Structure

```
nemotron-v3-home-security-intelligence/
├── docker-compose.prod.yml   # Container orchestration
├── backend/                  # FastAPI backend
│   ├── api/routes/          # REST + WebSocket endpoints
│   ├── services/            # AI pipeline, file watcher
│   └── models/              # SQLAlchemy models
├── frontend/                 # React dashboard
│   └── src/
│       ├── components/      # UI components
│       ├── hooks/           # WebSocket + data hooks
│       └── services/        # API client
├── ai/                       # AI service code
│   ├── gateway/             # Single AI entrypoint :8090 (router-per-model since bc7d6101)
│   ├── yolo26/              # Detection code (runs inside gateway in prod)
│   ├── nemotron/            # Risk reasoning LLM (port 8091)
│   └── florence/ clip/ enrichment/  # model code behind gateway routes
└── docs/                     # Documentation
```
